ModMetaData.name: RimUtinni Stick Cuisine
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description: Basic campfire skewer cooking: meat, veg, fungus, fruit and fish on a stick, plus the raw skewer resource - the "basic stuff" floor of the recipe-discovery tree (high_cuisine_deep_design.md, owner ruling 2026-09-02). Absorbs badoaks.meatonastick and badoaks.meatonastick.expansion (workshop 3435027361 / 3577333297): defs and mechanism ported and renamed under our own naming scheme, art NOT copied (no license found on either donor mod per BENCH's survey - art is regenerated in-house separately, currently placeholder/missing pending that pass). Both donor mods stay active pending retirement (owned by STICK_FOOD_INGEST_1).
